children: Prabhudas Lilladher's research report on Firstsource Solutions

FSOL delivered an in-line Q2FY27 performance, with rev. growth of 2.0% QoQ CC and EBIT margin of 12.5%. Revenue growth was led by BFS (+9.9% QoQ) and EMEA (+6% QoQ), while Healthcare declined 1.6% QoQ, due to delay in program ramp ups and transitions. Management indicated that the impact of the healthcare project cancellation (~ 1.5% of FY27E rev.) and payer program wind-down is largely behind, with new client additions and scope expansions supporting recovery prospects. Deal momentum remained strong, with 4 large deal wins (7th consecutive qtr. of 4+ wins), including 2 from new logos. Headcount addition by 3.06k was strong (highest since Q2FY25) largely in anticipation of deal ramp-ups and transition of a major banking client, with over 85% of incremental hiring in India and the Philippines. Management expects H2FY27 to outperform H1, supported by large-deal ramp-ups, strong hiring, improving conversion and robust pipeline. Accordingly, the company raised the lower end of its FY27 CC rev. growth guidance to 10.5% from 10% earlier, retaining the upper end at 13%, while maintaining EBIT margin guidance of 12.25–12.75%. EBIT margin expanded 10bps QoQ to 12.5% despite the first phase of wage hikes and costs of onboarding employees ahead of revenue. Continued offshore/nearshore delivery, AIled productivity and operating efficiencies support the margin trajectory towards FSOL’s medium-term aspiration of 15%. With strong H1 execution and improving growth visibility, we raise our FY27E/FY28E revenue CC growth estimates to 11.5%/10.9% from 11.1%/10.5%, respectively, while retaining FY29E estimates.

We also raise our FY27E/FY28E/FY29E EBIT margin estimates by 30bps each to 12.5%/13.0%/13.3% respectively, factoring in strong H1 performance. We continue to value the stock at 18x Sep. 28E earnings to arrive at TP of INR 350 and maintain our BUY rating.
